_help: Each letter is a sequence of directions: u d l r (up down left right) and tl tr bl br (the diagonals). Edit freely. A letter can list several sequences, e.g. ["bl br r", "bl br l"]. Two letters may not share an exact sequence. A sequence may be the start of a longer one (L = 'd r' starts F = 'd r r'); you finish a letter with a middle click, so that is fine. 'punctuation' is the list of marks the wheel walks through: scroll DOWN from rest, middle click to insert one. You may still add a "symbols" group (character -> sequence) if you want some marks on strokes.
